Profile
The Cooper Companies, Inc., branded as CooperCompanies, is a global medical device company headquartered in San Ramon, California. The company consists of two business units, CooperVision which manufactures contact lenses, and CooperSurgical, which manufactures medical devices and fertility and genomic products for the women's healthcare market.
